items.description:
Bootlegger Thatchfield is a branch of the Bootlegger coffee chain, based at Thatchfield Retail Centre on Brakfontein Road in Thatchfield, Centurion. The shop makes specialty grade coffee, which the business says it produces consistently and sustainably. The menu is built around all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch, served seven days a week from 7am.

Free WiFi and a kids menu are available, and takeaway options are offered at all Bootlegger stores. The business describes the shop as a place where people can connect and communities can grow. The website lists the shop's address as Shop 17, Thatchfield Retail Centre, with operating times of 7am to 6pm on most days and 7am to 5pm on Sundays.

Bourbon Eyewear is a South African brand that makes polarised sunglasses, and it says its aim is dependable performance, quality, comfort and style at an honest price. Every pair offers UV400 protection, with 100% UVA and UVB coverage. The brand says its lenses give enhanced clarity so vision stays clear in every light.

The frames are described as lightweight and durable, built for all-day wear on active days. The range is organised into collections, including fishing, golf, cycling, hunting, trail and photochromic styles, along with active, fashion, functional and polarised favourites. The brand says its polarised eyewear is designed for running, hiking, fishing and other outdoor activities.

Brandjam is a digital marketing agency in South Africa, and its website says it has more than 16 years of experience. The agency's view is that every client is different, so every design should be too.

Its services include WhatsApp marketing, AI SEO, social media marketing and management, copywriting, graphic design and website design. Its WhatsApp lead generation package sets up WhatsApp Business, runs Meta ads, adds automated replies and designs the ads, with the aim of turning advertising into enquiries sent straight to a business's WhatsApp. For social media, the agency focuses on educational, useful and visually vibrant posts that speak to existing, returning and new customers. Brandjam describes its work as combining informative copywriting with innovative design to build a client's online presence.

Breytenbach Embroidery does embroidery on a wide range of soft garments, from almost any fabric that fits under the needle. The business embroiders corporate wear, shirts, T-shirts, golf shirts, overalls, caps, ties, jackets, jerseys and beanies, and it also works on gifts such as towels. Digitising, the step that prepares a design for stitching, is part of the service. Its customers include sports clubs, clothing factories, schools and uniform suppliers.

The shop at 987 Pierneef Street in Villieria offers onsite services as well as online appointments, and its listing notes a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking. The business describes its work as fast, high-quality and detail-driven, with attentive guidance for each customer.

Browns is a jeweller with a boutique at Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, in shop G76 on the ground floor. The brand says it has been trading since 1934, when the first piece it made was for the founder's wife-to-be. Browns says it sells only natural diamonds, which it describes as ethical and traceable, and that its pieces are expertly crafted in solid gold and platinum.

Each piece carries the company's Maker's Mark, and the brand says its designs are unique and registered. The range includes engagement rings, women's and men's wedding bands, earrings, necklaces and bracelets, and custom-made pieces are made in the company's own workshop.

The brand offers 100% back on any trade-in and a buy-back after five years. The Menlyn Park boutique is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 6:30pm and on Sundays from 9am to 5:30pm.

Business Expert SA helps companies turn their data into clear business decisions. Its services include business intelligence dashboards that centralise KPIs, operational data and growth figures, along with automated reporting, KPI tracking and strategic analytics. The business says it works with business owners, teams and decision-makers, and that its focus is making reporting clearer, operations smarter and growth easier to manage.

Its approach combines business understanding with data structure, automation and visual intelligence, so clients can see what matters, respond faster and plan with confidence. Solutions are described as custom for each business, with reporting designed to drive outcomes. The website also lists 24/7 insight availability and presents its dashboards as secure and built for business confidence.

Car Care Workshop Lynnwood is an automotive workshop that says it has five years of service behind it. Its work covers routine maintenance, such as oil changes, tyre rotations, fluid checks and filter replacements, along with mechanical repairs for complex faults and vehicle upgrades. The workshop says its facility uses diagnostic tools to find potential problems before they become major ones.

Its technicians are described as highly skilled, and the business says the team has many years of collective experience in the automotive field. Customers can book online through the website. The business says its focus is customer satisfaction and continued growth in expertise, with the aim of keeping each vehicle running smoothly and reliably.

Casewise SA is an erwin reseller for Africa and has been a value-added reseller in South Africa since 2001. The company is an erwin Diamond Partner, a status the website says it has held since 2001. Its solutions help organisations visualise, understand, analyse and audit business strategy, complex operating processes, information flows, application deployment and IT infrastructure.

Its services include enterprise architecture and business process management, along with business process analysis, information management, and governance, risk and compliance. The website says the company supports many of the world's leading organisations across a wide range of vertical markets. It describes its aim as helping businesses stay competitive when processes, teams and technology create complexity and friction.

Castle Walk Flowers, which its website calls Castlewalk Flower Market, sells hand-crafted flower arrangements, bouquets and flower baskets. Customers can choose their own flowers for a vase, bouquet, arrangement or basket, or ask for a personalised arrangement for each occasion. The florists design for weddings, funerals and receptions, and the business also offers flower contracts.

The business says it selects only the best flowers and aims for superior quality, attention to detail and freshness at low prices. Its florists are described as experts in floral design who want to create only the best arrangements. The website presents the market as a friendly place to find every floral need.

Cemcrete is a family-owned South African manufacturer of decorative cement coatings and specialised construction products, in business since 1973. Its range includes microcement, terrazzo overlays, decorative wall coatings, pool finishes, waterproofing systems and other cement-based solutions for interior and exterior surfaces. The company says its products are specified by architects, interior designers, contractors and homeowners across Southern Africa and internationally, for residential, commercial, retail and hospitality projects.

Cemcrete has four showrooms and three warehouses in Johannesburg, Centurion and Cape Town. Its products are also stocked by third-party retailers across Southern Africa, Mauritius and further afield. The website shows featured projects and style guides.

Centigrade Refrigeration is a custom refrigeration business serving southern Africa, and it describes itself as a leader in coldroom solutions. It designs and builds cold rooms and freezer rooms, including custom-built walk-in chillers, preparation areas and residential cold-storage solutions. Its range also includes glass-door display systems for cold and freezer rooms, door solutions in swing, sliding, personnel and container styles, and modular buildings.

Accessories include strip curtains, meat rails, S-hooks and shelving. Its smart monitoring service tracks coldroom temperature 24 hours a day and sends instant SMS alerts, which the company says help protect stock and reduce downtime. Each solution is designed around the customer's temperature, capacity and daily use.

Chandel Security offers security services to individuals and to businesses. For individuals it provides CCTV solutions, security manpower, alarm monitoring, risk assessments and investigations. For businesses it offers security audits, system analysis, threat analysis, and security for corporate events.

The company describes its offering as complete security solutions and highlights its risk management services. Its team is made up of operational and technical specialists, and the company says its suppliers are kept up to date with global trends and market needs. The website highlights excellent follow-up, turnaround time and product knowledge, and says the company has offices and satellite branches in every service area.

Clampon (Pty) Ltd manufactures slurry pinch valves and HDPE and PVC couplings and fittings for the mining, waterworks and related industries. The company says it manufactures locally and works throughout Africa with mining corporations. Its valves include the open-frame slurry pinch valve and the Max-Flo enclosed pinch valve, which the company offers as direct replacements for diaphragm valves. Pressure ratings run from 1000 kPa to 4000 kPa, and sizes range from 50 mm to 500 mm, with larger sizes built to client specification.

Refurbishment takes 7 to 10 working days and costs 50 to 60% of a new valve. Standard finish is QD enamel, with powder coating, electroplating and galvanising available on request.

CLS Human Capital Specialists is a Pretoria-based firm offering human resources and organisational development solutions, in business since 1996. The firm says it provides a full spectrum of HR solutions, focusing mainly on small and medium-sized enterprises. It partners with small and medium businesses and builds specialised services around each company's unique needs, including customised HR consulting.

The firm believes human capital development is vital to the growth of all enterprises. Its stated values are professionalism, excellence, care for people, trustworthiness, ownership of work, teamwork and clear communication. The website invites businesses to get in touch to discuss how the firm's services can fit their people needs.

ColourCraft Print is a Pretoria printing company operating from 116 Lys Street in Rietondale, and it says it has been running since 2000. Its work falls into four areas.

Lithographic printing is aimed at long runs and bulk jobs with consistent colour, covering business stationery and letterheads, quotation, delivery and invoice books, medical and clinical forms, diaries, desk pads, flyers and brochures. Digital printing suits shorter runs and quick-turnaround jobs, including short-run stationery, personalised documents, proofs and variable data printing. The branding range covers vehicle branding and wraps, gazebos and event structures, signage and safety signs, exhibition displays, banners and promotional merchandise. The company also produces cut-to-shape and roll stickers and labels, including product and packaging labels, safety labels, window and floor graphics.

Conscius is an independent corporation of electrical and electronic consulting engineers, with offices in Johannesburg, Pretoria and Mauritius. Its stated objective is to provide and integrate innovative, cost-effective electrical engineering services, with an emphasis on financial control and risk management.

Its clients include government bodies, parastatal institutions, regional services councils, city councils and municipalities, as well as private developers, industrialists, corporate offices, major retail shopping centre projects and hospitals. Its services cover electrical infrastructure development, master plans, upgrading of existing electrical networks, macro and micro electrical infrastructure, and electrical and electronic services. Projects listed on the website include pressure reducing and pressure protection station control, and SCADA and control systems on a Sasol pipeline project in Polokwane, completed in 2015.

Constructo describes itself as a high-performance contractor and a future-facing mining services company focused on operational excellence. The company says it helps clients extract value safely and efficiently, and that it delivers on time, every time. It works in environments that include remote locations, community-sensitive areas, and high-risk, high-value projects.

Constructo highlights sustainable mine rehabilitation among its services, and says the environment, health and safety of its employees are integral to all of its operations. The company says its people are resilient, highly skilled, disciplined and growth-focused, and that its consistent delivery mindset and internal culture set it apart from other service providers. It states an ambition to grow beyond its current capacity and to reach new clients.

Contact Labour (Pty) Ltd, which trades as Cont@ct Labour, is a labour law and HR services firm for South African businesses. Its labour law practitioners provide CCMA representation at the Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration, and support employers through disciplinary hearings that aim to meet legal standards. Its labour relations support covers day-to-day employer-employee relations, with the aim of keeping operations running while minimising risk. The firm also offers wider HR solutions and guidance on the Labour Acts that govern employment.

The website lists Employment Equity (EE) and skills services among its offerings. The practitioners work across South Africa and combine technical knowledge of employment legislation with practical business sense.

CSI Clutch & Brake (South Africa) (Pty) Ltd was founded on 18 October 1988 and supplies new, high-quality TRAX clutch and brake parts for trucks, buses, agricultural equipment, passenger cars, LDVs and 4x4 vehicles. It also supplies new and refurbished brake and clutch equipment.

The company has a factory that refurbishes clutches for all makes of trucks, buses, tractors, cars, LDVs and 4x4s. Its clutch range includes clutch kits, driven and pressure plates, clutch bearings, slave cylinders and components such as facings, rivets and diaphragms. Its brake range includes heavy-duty brake linings, brake drums and discs, disc brake pads, bonded brake shoes, bonding adhesives and brake hoses. Equipment offered includes brake lining and clutch plate riveters, bonding ovens, lathes for brake drums and discs, and clutch test benches.

De Souza Hardware & Brick Depot in Hestea Park is a supplier of building materials in Pretoria. It stocks a wide range of bricks and blocks in many shapes, textures and sizes from well-known brands, along with paving bricks in different sizes, colours and textures. Its sand range includes plaster sand, building sand, topsoil, a sand and stone blend and play pen sand. Stone is available in 6mm, 13mm and 19mm sizes, along with crusher dust.

For cement, the business stocks PPC Surebuild 32.5 and BB Cement 32.5. The business also carries other building products in store, and says it has over 12 staff members who strive for efficiency and quality. Its website describes the business as a name customers can trust.

Design a Cake is a bespoke cake studio based in Amandasig, Pretoria, creating custom wedding cakes, celebration cakes and cakes for high teas and other personal occasions. Each order starts with a consultation so that a design, size and flavour can be worked out to match the occasion, and the studio offers flavours such as vanilla, chocolate, carrot and hummingbird alongside personalised decoration for every cake. The business is women-owned and focuses on individual, made-to-order cakes rather than a standard shelf range.

Customers can book a consultation by appointment, and finished cakes can be collected from the studio or delivered, with cake stand rental also available for the day of an event. The studio operates from 22 Karee Street in Amandasig, Pretoria, making it a personal option for couples planning a wedding cake or anyone wanting a custom-designed cake for a birthday, high tea or other celebration.

Dexitt Brand Design is a graphic design and branding studio based in Centurion, Pretoria, working with clients across Gauteng, South Africa and internationally. The studio says its work spans hospitality, law, engineering and finance. Its services include custom logo design, full brand identity systems, style guides, business cards and stationery. It also produces marketing and advertising material such as flyers, brochures, posters, digital adverts and email newsletter visuals.

Social media design covers branded post templates, Instagram and Facebook content, highlight covers and story templates. Print design includes packaging, product labels and tags, booklets and catalogues. The studio says each project begins with listening, and that its design should clarify rather than complicate.

Dis-Chem Thatchfield Pharmacy is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy and health retailer, at Thatchfield Retail Centre on Brakfontein Road in Thatchfield, Centurion. The store has a dispensary and offers click and collect. It also has an in-store clinic, a baby wellness clinic and a hair salon.

Store hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 6:30pm, Saturday 9am to 5pm and Sunday 9am to 4pm. The clinic and baby wellness clinic open on weekdays from 9am to 5:30pm and are closed on Saturdays and Sundays, but open from 9am to 2pm on public holidays. The hair salon opens on weekdays from 8:30am and on Saturdays from 8am to 4pm.

DJM Tax & Business Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a business administration services firm in Irene, Pretoria, and its LinkedIn page lists seven employees. Beyond tax, it describes itself as a strategic extension of its clients' teams. Its services include registering new businesses with CIPC, SARS, the Department of Labour, the workmen's compensation fund and other official bodies. It mentors business owners on policies and procedures so their finances and administration stay under control, and can bring in specialist consultants for quality control.

Payroll administration is offered on Sage Payroll Online, Simple Pay and Intercode Payroll, alongside HR control, bookkeeping and accounting. The firm is a partner for Sage Online Accounting, QuickBooks and Xero, offering implementation, training and support.

Earthcor is a manufacturer and supplier of earthing and lightning protection products, which the company describes as Southern Africa's largest manufacturer of copper, brass and alloy solutions. Its product range includes earth rods, conductors, clamps and connectors, exothermic welding under the Thermexweld name, couplings, driving caps and drill tips, and grounding tapes and putties. The company says its earthing and lightning protection products are Eskom approved.

The website lists branches in Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban, Port Elizabeth and Wadeville. It also publishes quality standards, downloads, a mass calculation formula and copper flat bar conductor ratings for technical users. The site is published by Copalcor (Pty) Ltd.

Earthen Coffee Roasters is a South African coffee roaster, established in 2015, that sells fresh roasted coffee at retail and wholesale. Its range includes single origins, coffee blends and decaf, and it sells both whole beans and ground coffee. The roaster describes coffee as a fruit to be enjoyed fresh, and its website describes its coffee as a symphony of flavours from around the world. The website also offers brewing guidance, including a recipe for black coffee made in an AeroPress with a medium-fine grind and a steep time of at least eight minutes.

In store, customers can ask for a specific grind size. The business ships internationally to Mauritius, the UAE and the UK.

East Side Doors and Security is a garage door and security business serving Pretoria East, Centurion and other parts of Gauteng. It installs, repairs and maintains garage doors, and offers emergency garage door repairs around the clock.

The company installs doors from manufacturers including Centurion, Gemini and Digidoor, in traditional, carriage house and contemporary designer styles. Its other services include automatic gates and fences for security and privacy, CCTV camera installation for homes and businesses, controlled access to property, and irrigation installations. The website also promotes garage door operators for residential roll-up doors, which the company says offer reliable operation through door load profiling.

Ecotech Audio Visual is a Pretoria company that designs, installs and commissions audio-visual and video production systems. The business says it fills the gap between imported equipment and commissioned systems, delivering turnkey solutions for the audio-visual market.

Its work includes data projectors for boardrooms and plasma and LCD screen equipment. Its listing describes audio-visual equipment sales and hire, as well as video production. The website gives its address as 3 Kameeldrift, Roodeplaat, Pretoria.

A separate ECOTECH Furniture range covers office furniture and executive design furniture. The company describes itself as the connection, using the Zulu word Hlanganisa. The Cylex listing tags the business under computer stores and computer repairs, and shows it open Monday to Friday, with weekday hours of 8am to 5pm (Monday from 8:15am) and closed at weekends.

items.reason: No reliable external source confirms the construction services in the current description; the business's own website fails to resolve (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED), and appearing only in PretoriaHub's own directory text isn't independent evidence. Held pending independent confirmation.

items.description:
Builders Express Wonderpark is a hardware and home-improvement store trading under the Builders chain, serving customers in Karenpark and the wider Pretoria area. The store stocks a day-to-day range for DIY projects and building work, including paint, hand and power tools, hardware fittings and general building materials, alongside the wider product range carried across the Builders Express format. Shoppers can browse and buy in person, and the store also supports delivery and collection options for customers who would rather not carry their purchases home themselves.

Customers can shop in-store, arrange same-day delivery, have larger orders delivered off-site, or place an order online for in-store pickup, giving several ways to get hold of materials for a project. The store trades from Wonderpark Shopping Centre on Doreg Avenue in Karenpark, Pretoria, making it a convenient hardware stop for homeowners, DIY enthusiasts and small building contractors working in the area.

Bulkhead Solutions manufactures prefabricated gypsum-board bulkheads, the ceiling features used to conceal services or create a stepped ceiling design, as an alternative to building a bulkhead from scratch on site. Each bulkhead is made in the factory from 9mm or 12.5mm gypsum board, cut and shaped to the dimensions a project requires, so that it arrives ready to fit rather than needing to be built up panel by panel on site. The business has been operating since 1993, giving it decades of experience producing bulkheads for the construction industry.

Its bulkheads are supplied to architects, interior architects, interior designers and construction companies, who can have finished units collected from the factory or delivered to site for installation. The business is based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, and remains in operation despite its age, continuing to serve the Pretoria building and design trade from this address.

items.reason: Could not independently confirm that the Copperleaf Golf Estate address matches the business's own website; the service information found (business-boutique.co.za) is self-described only, with no independent source tying it to this address. Held pending confirmation.

items.description:
Cash Crusaders-Schubart is a branch of the Cash Crusaders retail chain, operating as a second-hand goods store in Pretoria CBD. The branch buys and sells pre-owned electronics, tools, appliances and other household and tech items, giving customers in the city centre a place to sell goods they no longer need or to buy second-hand stock at a lower price than new. As part of a long-running national chain, the branch follows the same buy-sell-trade model used across its other stores.

The branch trades from Shop 11 in the Poyntons Building, on the corner of Church Street and Schubart Street in Pretoria CBD, a location separately recorded under the same branch name in a historical government gazette listing. It is a practical stop for shoppers and sellers in the central business district looking to buy or sell second-hand electronics and other everyday items without needing to travel out of town.

items.reason: Likely inactive: both ccrslegal.co.za pages still show an Afrihost 'Domain Inactive' notice, and no reliable source connects this name or address to an active practice. Not assumed closed from an inactive site alone, but not published either; held for a deeper pass or owner confirmation.

Wrong-business-match concern: the only source found for this address/category identifies a different business, 'Jock Ceilings / Ceiling and Drywall Installation Experts Pretoria', not clearly this Ceiling Experts listing. Held until the business behind this listing can be confirmed.

items.description:
Chamberlain Waterkloof Glen is a branch of Chamberlain, a South African hardware and building-materials chain that has traded since 1903. The Waterkloof Glen branch operates as a full builder's yard, supplying paint, adhesives, power tools, plumbing supplies and garden equipment, and it runs its own garden centre for plants and outdoor products. In-store paint mixing is available, along with board cutting and edging for customers working on cabinetry or shelving projects.

The branch also has a bulk and direct sales department for trade and larger-quantity orders, an in-store coffee shop for customers who want a break while they shop, and gift cards for customers to buy or redeem. It trades from 378 Roslyn Avenue in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, Saturdays from 8am to 3pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm.

Checkers Clubview is a supermarket serving the Clubview area of Centurion, selling groceries, fresh produce and everyday household goods under the Checkers banner. Alongside its main grocery floor, the store operates its own in-store LiquorShop for customers buying wine, beer and spirits as part of their regular shop, and a Petshop Science facility for pet food and pet-care products, so shoppers can pick up pet supplies without a separate trip to a specialist store.

These on-site departments set the branch apart from a standard grocery-only supermarket, giving Clubview residents a single stop for food, drink and pet needs. The store trades from 94 Lyttelton Road on the corner of Von Willich Avenue in Clubview, Centurion, and is a convenient full-range grocery option for households and families living in the surrounding suburb.

Checkers Hyper Mayville is a large-format Checkers supermarket trading from Mayville Mall in Pretoria, stocking a wide grocery range alongside fresh food, a bakery and a deli counter. The hyper format also includes prepared foods, a salad bar for customers wanting a ready-made meal, and restaurant facilities on site, so shoppers can eat in as well as stock up for home. Customers can also order online for delivery or choose in-store pickup once an order is ready.

These added food-service facilities go beyond a standard supermarket shop, making the branch a destination for a full meal as well as a weekly grocery run. The store is based in Mayville Mall on the corner of Van Rensburg Street and Nienaber Avenue in Mayville, Pretoria, serving households and workers in and around the suburb who want groceries, fresh food or a sit-down meal in one visit.

Clear Creative Lizelle is a graphic design and digital services studio based in La Montagne, Pretoria, producing social media graphics and promotional materials for client campaigns. The studio also designs websites, working to align each site's look and content with the client's existing branding so that a business presents the same identity online as it does across its other marketing. Its work sits at the point where design and digital marketing meet, covering both the visuals a business uses and the website that carries them.

Clients bring their branding guidelines, and the studio builds graphics, campaign materials and web pages that fit within them, rather than starting from a blank slate each time. The studio operates from 209 Kandelaar Avenue in La Montagne, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, serving small and medium businesses in the area that need ongoing design support for their marketing and website.

Clicks Watermeyer is a retail pharmacy and health and beauty store trading from Watermeyer Park Shopping Centre in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria. The store combines a dispensing pharmacy, offering prescription medicines and pharmacist advice, with a full retail range covering beauty and cosmetics, vitamins and supplements, and baby products, so that everyday health, beauty and family shopping can be done under one roof. An in-store clinic adds a further health service on site, letting customers see a clinic nurse for tests, vaccinations or minor treatments without needing a separate appointment elsewhere.

That combination of pharmacy, clinic and retail sets the branch apart from a pharmacy counter alone. The store is based in Watermeyer Park Shopping Centre on Watermeyer Street in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, serving shoppers in the surrounding suburbs who want medicine, healthcare and everyday beauty or baby products in a single visit.

items.reason: Status concern: National Credit Regulator records show its credit-provider registration was voluntarily cancelled on 30 September 2015, and there is insufficient evidence it is still operating as an active coal trader. Held pending confirmation the business is still trading.

Wrong-business-match concern: could not confirm that the IT security, training and resourcing business trading as Columbus (columbussa.co.za) is the same company as this Southdowns Ridge, Irene listing; that site never mentions Columbus Consulting or the Regus location. Held pending confirmation.

Do not publish as an ordinary consulting business: South Africa's Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) publicly warned in 2020 that Crowd1 was not authorised to provide the financial services it offered and was suspected of operating as a pyramid scheme, referring it to the SA Reserve Bank for investigation; the COMESA Competition Commission separately issued its own consumer alert. This listing must not be described as a legitimate consulting business without independent confirmation that current Centurion operations are lawful and unconnected to those regulatory findings. Held pending that confirmation.

items.description:
DA Graphix is a printing and branding business based in Valhalla, Centurion, offering a wide range of custom print and signage work. Its services include signage, canvas printing, custom labels, laser cutting and engraving, 3D printing and sublimation printing, alongside more everyday print jobs such as business cards, banners and t-shirt printing. Sandblasting is also offered for jobs that need an etched or engraved finish rather than a printed one.

The range covers both digital and physical branding needs, from a single business card order to large-format banners and signage for a shopfront or event. Customers can shop and collect their orders in person at the store, which trades from Shop 7, 11 Fergus Road in Valhalla, Centurion, making it a local option for individuals and small businesses in the area needing printing, signage or custom branding work done nearby.

Deedscon Consult (Pty) Ltd is a black-owned engineering consulting firm established in 2007, offering development and engineering consulting, project management, technical training and mentorship, and occupational health and safety services. Government tender documentation has identified the firm as acting as a principal agent and civil engineer on public infrastructure work, confirming it operates as a registered engineering and project-management practice rather than only a general consultancy.

That combination of civil engineering, project management and training lets the firm support a project from technical design through to delivery and on-site safety compliance. Deedscon Consult is based at 52 Panorama Road in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, and its engineering and project management services are suited to government bodies, developers and contractors needing a registered civil engineer and principal agent for infrastructure and development projects.

Delacon is a town-planning and municipal-legislation consulting practice based in Doringkloof, Centurion, working on land-use management, rezoning and other planning applications for property owners and developers. The practice is multidisciplinary, also covering strategic and integrated development planning and social housing work, and applications relating to heritage and planning legislation, so it can advise on a project from initial land-use questions through to the legislative approvals a municipality requires.

The wider Delacon Group that the practice forms part of also offers fire-related services, including the sale, servicing and installation of fire equipment, and draughting and design of building plans, broadening the support available to clients beyond planning alone. Delacon is based at 101 Karin Avenue in Doringkloof, Centurion, serving property owners, developers and public-sector clients who need town-planning or municipal-legislation advice in the Centurion and wider Pretoria area.

items.reason: No reliable source connects this listing to the website-development, e-commerce, SEO and branding services in the current description; similarly-named Dorbyl businesses exist but must not be used as a source for this listing. Held pending confirmation of what this specific business does.

items.description:
Douglasdale Dairy (Pty) Ltd is a dairy manufacturer based in Hennopspark, Centurion, supplying milk and dairy products to the South African market. Its range includes full cream, low-fat and fat-free milk, as well as amasi, fresh cream and buttermilk, giving it a broad spread across both everyday drinking milk and cultured and cream products. As a manufacturer, the business produces dairy products for distribution through retail and food-service channels rather than operating as a single retail outlet.

The company operates from 157 Edison Crescent in Hennopspark, Centurion, the address confirmed for this listing. Its own website remains active under the Douglasdale Dairy name, confirming that the business is still producing and distributing milk, amasi, fresh cream and buttermilk from this Hennopspark base to customers across South Africa.

items.reason: Thin even after a deeper pass: Medpages confirms the practice type (GP) and the 390 Yukon Avenue, Eersterust address, with its record updated 14 August 2025 (so clearly current), but no services, specialism or hours detail was found beyond that, which isn't enough to carry a full, non-padded description. Held pending more detail.

Address mismatch: the only source (Facebook, as 'Dream Dynasty Group') gives Central Towers, Office 506, Pretorius Street, not the listed 72 Ruth First Street, Lotus Gardens address; its category labels (printing, construction, events) are too broad to know what this specific listing does. Held pending a reliable source for this address.
